from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace')

print('program dir', p.parent.exists())
demo='''0 5 5 5 5 5 5 5 0
5 0 0 5 0 0 5 5 0
0 5 0 0 0 5 5 0 5
0 0 5 5 5 5 7 7 7
0 5 0 5 5 5 5 7 5
0 0 5 5 5 2 7 5 7
6 6 6 0 5 5 0 0 0
6 6 6 0 5 5 0 0 0
6 6 6 5 5 0 0 0 0'''
demo_grid=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in demo.splitlines()]
# Write transform which downsamples 3x3 blocks, extracting non-background symbols.
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    # Each output cell summarizes one 3x3 patch. 0 and 5 are background.\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for r in range(0, h, 3):\n        row = []\n        for c in range(0, w, 3):\n            colors = [grid[i][j] for i in range(r, min(r+3, h))\n                      for j in range(c, min(c+3, w)) if grid[i][j] not in (0, 5)]\n            row.append(Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0] if colors else 0)\n        out.append(row)\n    return out\n''')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print(mod.transform(demo_grid))
